CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Warp animation speed — higher values spin the tunnel faster.
CONTROLS.NAME: fly_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Tilt view up/down. Shifts the vortex centre vertically.
CONTROLS.NAME: pitch

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Roll the view. Rotates the warp tunnel.
CONTROLS.NAME: roll_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pan the view left/right. Shifts the vortex centre horizontally.
CONTROLS.NAME: yaw_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How strongly bass pulses the animation speed and brightness.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_reactivity

DESCRIPTION: Polar-warp tunnel of coloured dots. Pitch, yaw, and roll shift the vortex centre and rotate the view. Fly speed controls animation rate. Bass pulses brightness and speed.
TITLE: Warper
